# `row`

Helper: `row({ g, ai, jc }, ...kids)`  
Kit (`src/ui`): none (plain flex row, wraps) · status: none  
App (KMP `core:ui`): `Row` (Compose primitive)

## Anatomy

Horizontal flex container that wraps.

## Variants

- `g` gap, `ai` align-items, `jc` justify-content

## States

- Static: it has no hover, focus or disabled state of its own

## Tokens

space scale

## Do

- Use for buttons and fields on one line

## Don't

- Do not nest a `row` in a `row` for layout

## Web (1440 and 1920)

Wraps when the line is full.

## Mobile (390)

Wraps; fields take the full width.

## Rules (design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md)

Container. `ai` align-items, `jc` justify-content (`'space-between'`, `'flex-end'`)
